newsitem.title: USA: Grigsby Brandford says Calvin Grigsby resigns.
newsitem.headline: Grigsby Brandford says Calvin Grigsby resigns.

text.p: Calvin B. Grigsby has resigned as chairman of San Francisco-based Grigsby Brandford & Co, according to a news release on Tuesday from the firm.
Grigsby, the long-time chairman of the minority-owned firm he founded in 1981, could not be reached for comment.
In the release, he said that he was "looking forward to this as a major intersection in my life after a career devoted primarily to Grigsby Brandford & Co."
"I'm proud of Grigsby Brandford, the contribution it has made, and I'm eager to pursue new opportunities at this stage in my life," he said.
Napolean Brandford, the firm's vice chairman, was appointed to chairman of the board by the private firm's shareholders.
Suzanne Shank, a managing director for Grigsby Brandford based in the Midwest, was named president and chief executive officer, according to the release.
